'''''Before the Storm''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]]. It is the first book in the [[The Black Fleet Crisis|''Black Fleet Crisis'']] trilogy, and it was first published in [[March]] [[1996]]. A sequel, ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', was published later that year.
